title: Young Boy Sitting on Dirt Pile, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white 1955 snapshot featuring a young boy named Cary sitting happily atop a pile of dirt or gravel. He is wearing a striped top, dungarees, and sneakers. Behind him is a dark slatted wooden shed or barn wall. The print features classic scalloped deckled edges and a frame date mark reading MAY 55.
